receipt_definition: A receipt is a public, checkable account of what was attempted, what context and proof were used, what changed, what was rejected or deferred, and what future work may inherit.

receipt_types.name: Import Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records that source material entered as witness-only candidate context.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Never inheritable by itself; must pass classification and settlement.

receipt_types.name: Classification Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records how witness material became candidate continuity objects.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Classification creates candidate objects only; accepted inheritance still requires settlement.

receipt_types.name: Settlement Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records accepted, rejected, deferred, or review-required outcomes for candidate objects.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Accepted and accepted_with_caveats objects may become inheritable when receipt-cited.

receipt_types.name: Inheritance Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records the accepted-only context bundle exported to a future session or carrier.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Defines what the named future session or carrier may rely on.

receipt_types.name: Visibility Trace Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records what retrieval considered, returned, excluded, and cited.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Trace is proof of retrieval boundaries, not an accepted-state mutation.

receipt_types.name: Route Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records why a carrier, tool, or human review path was selected.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Route decisions are inheritable only as operational context, not as proof that carrier output is true.

receipt_types.name: Deployment Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records a Google Cloud or hosted runtime deployment event.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Deployment facts may be inherited after health proof; production readiness remains a separate claim.

receipt_types.name: Demo Claim Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records which demo claims are proven, local-only, live, roadmap, or non-claims.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Accepted demo claims may be used in submission assets; unsupported claims must not be presented as proof.

receipt_types.name: Release Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records the validation and proof boundary for a release candidate or contest submission.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Release receipts can be cited by demo and audit material.

receipt_types.name: Adapter Path Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records how an object moved through an external system adapter, normalized object, authority classification, and cross-surface settlement path.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Adapter-derived objects may inherit only through the settled lineage path and receipt.

receipt_types.name: Continuation Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records a portable context package or continuation packet replay across carriers, devices, or local machines.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Future sessions may inherit only the receipt-cleared context included in the package scope.

receipt_types.name: Voice Confirmation Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records that a high-risk voice-derived instruction was paused, clarified, confirmed, or blocked.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Voice-derived packets remain non-executable for high-risk actions until confirmation is receipted.

receipt_types.name: Security Containment Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records bounded red-team or high-risk testing in a lab environment with synthetic secrets and containment boundaries.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Security findings may be inherited as warnings or tasks, not as proof of production security certification.

receipt_types.name: First Contact Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records creation of a project-bound continuity lane and first contact package for a public GPT or other carrier.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Project identity can route future packets, but project_id alone does not grant mutation authority.

receipt_types.name: Collaboration Receipt
receipt_types.purpose: Records scoped project invitations, collaborator roles, and capability-token boundaries.
receipt_types.inheritance_rule: Collaborator actions become shared state only through settlement and receipt-backed inheritance.

inheritance_status_rules.accepted: May inherit when receipt-cited and inside role/domain scope.
inheritance_status_rules.accepted_with_caveats: May inherit only with caveat text preserved.
inheritance_status_rules.rejected: May appear as witness or warning, but not as trusted context.
inheritance_status_rules.deferred: May appear as pending work, but not as accepted fact.
inheritance_status_rules.needs_human_review: May not inherit as trusted state until review is settled.
inheritance_status_rules.needs_more_proof: May not inherit as trusted state until proof is supplied and settled.
inheritance_status_rules.merged: May inherit through the target merged object and receipt.
inheritance_status_rules.archived_as_witness: May be inspected but not trusted.
